name: The CUT Culinary training at The Door (ages 17 to 24)
what_you_do: A 12 week cooking and kitchen training program in Manhattan. Trainees earn a stipend for their hours.
who_can_apply: Ages 17 to 24. All Door job programs need free Door membership first.
pay_detail: Stipend of up to $3,100 over 150 hours
deadline_text: Start dates are not posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Become a Door member (free), then contact Latasha Stephens at Lstephens@door.org or 917-696-3758.
notes: Other Door job programs have other age rules, such as 18 to 24 for several of them. Call first to ask about the next start date.
